label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (100% of activation mass; never at D2, about 19 D1 steps). Within GO, 96% of mass follows an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward == 0); it almost never fires after a rewarded one. It also fades over the episode: rate is 0.22 at ep_trial 1 and about 0.11 over trials 0-9, falling to about 0 after trial 80, so (ep_trial < 50) raises precision from 0.26 to 0.47 while keeping 92% of mass. It also tracks model value (82% of mass in the 7.73-8.10 value bin; none in the top bin) and favors trials where the policy picks a1 (72% of mass, rate 0.16 vs 0.06 for a2), but adding a1 or a value threshold trades recall for precision with no clear F1 gain (value > 7.7 gives F1 0.65 on dev). Its magnitude is not explained by stay/switch, transition type or core pattern, and those are only weakly related to it. Uses only observed variables.
